stories.headline: Exclusive: DeepMind veteran Thore Graepel quits to pursue AI reasoning venture
stories.summary: Thore Graepel, a prominent veteran researcher at Google DeepMind, has left the company to launch a new startup focused on AI reasoning. Graepel, who played a key role in landmark projects like AlphaGo, joins a growing list of high-profile AI researchers departing major labs to build independent ventures.

stories.headline: Jensen's purchase of a new toy could reshape the entire AI industry
stories.summary: Nvidia has reportedly acquired Hugging Face, the leading open-source AI model repository, for $12.9 billion. The acquisition has sparked concerns among industry analysts about the potential fragmentation and siloing of AI development, despite assurances that the platform will remain open. This acquisition represents a major consolidation of AI software infrastructure under the dominant AI chipmaker.
